analyst_view.overall: Celta (27th, 3 points) host Bournemouth (2nd, 12 points from four wins) at Balaidos. Bournemouth under Marco Rose are flying: eight straight league wins, the latest 2-0 against Nottingham Forest, with Evanilson scoring in five league games running; they are still without Alex Toth and Juanlu Sanchez, with Julian Araujo unlikely, and Rose has said Alex Scott will start only one of the Forest, Celta and Fulham games, so some rotation is likely. Celta have won one of their last five (a cup game at Salamanca), lost at Real Madrid and Rayo and drew 0-0 with Levante; striker Borja Iglesias is listed as doubtful with a calf problem, while Starfelt and Miguel Roman are back in training. None of these players are in the numbers' missing list. I lean slightly lower on goals because Celta's attack looks blunt and may lack Iglesias; the rest stays with the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals, 1.2 for Celta and 1.8 for Bournemouth, and already trim Celta for scoring only 4 in their last 6. Borja Iglesias, their main striker, is doubtful with a calf injury and is not in the missing list, and Bournemouth may rotate a little with Fulham next; that is a mild reason to go lower, to about 2.9.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.4 corners, split fairly evenly. Bournemouth's direct, wide play (Tavernier, Kluivert, Rayan) and Celta's wing-backs both produce corners, and recent corner form is already in the numbers, so I stay at about 8.4.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards and already lower Bournemouth for being booked less lately (-5.2%). No referee is named yet and nothing suggests a heated game, so I stay at about 3.7.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.2 shots and already raise Celta for shooting a lot lately (+8.2%), even if few go in. Possible Bournemouth rotation (Scott on minutes management, Kroupi pushing to start) does not clearly change volume, so I stay at about 26.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.8 on target and already cut Celta's share for poor accuracy (-9.6%). Bournemouth's in-form forward line, led by Evanilson, keeps their side of it high, so I stay at about 8.8.
